product_family: Endel is a sound wellness application that generates personalized, adaptive soundscapes using AI to help users focus, relax, sleep, and move. Available across iOS, Android, Apple Watch, Apple TV, Amazon Alexa, Mac, Windows, and web.

certifications.name: Fairly Trained (AI Ethics - Licensed Model)
certifications.proof_quote: Endel is among the companies that has received the Licensed Model (L) certification from Fairly Trained, a non-profit that certifies generative AI companies for training data practices that respect creators' rights.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: Endel is the 'controller' within the meaning of the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and complies with applicable US data protection laws, including the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). Data transfers to the US are secured by the EU-US Data Privacy Framework.

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type 1 or 2)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of SOC 2 certification found. Privacy policy and website do not mention SOC 2 audit or certification.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27001 certification found. Privacy policy and security documentation do not reference this certification.

certifications.name: ISO 27018 (Cloud Data Protection)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27018 certification found despite AWS data storage. This certification would apply to cloud service providers, not necessarily to Endel as a consumer application.

certifications.name: HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA compliance. HIPAA applies to covered entities in healthcare; Endel is a consumer wellness application outside the scope of HIPAA regulatory requirements.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Management Systems)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 42001 certification. This is an emerging standard and not commonly held by consumer AI applications.

certifications.name: CSA STAR (Cloud Security Alliance)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of CSA STAR certification found.

privacy.terms_url: https://endel.io/ (Terms referenced in app but not directly published on website)
privacy.ai_training_note: Endel holds Fairly Trained certification, indicating its generative AI models are trained on licensed data, not on user-generated soundscapes or personal listening data. User data is used for real-time personalization within the app but not for retraining the underlying AI model.

flags: No published trust center or security documentation page on vendor domain.
No SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certifications despite using AWS; these are common for SaaS companies but not universally required for consumer wellness apps.

Fairly Trained certification is an AI ethics/training-data certification, not a traditional security/compliance certification. It confirms licensed AI training practices but does not cover infrastructure security, encryption standards, or data protection audits.
Encryption specifications (algorithms, key lengths, in-transit/at-rest) are not publicly documented.
HIPAA is not mentioned; this is appropriate as Endel is not a covered entity under HIPAA, though it does collect health-adjacent data (heart rate, location). GDPR protections apply instead.

Data storage on AWS SARL is noted, but no reference to AWS's own certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001) is made in Endel's privacy policy; the vendor should clarify whether AWS certifications extend to Endel's use.
No formal security audit report or certification letter found on public vendor domain.
Company maturity is 'growth' (Series A funded, 4M+ downloads, 1M+ monthly active users) rather than 'enterprise' due to lack of formal security certifications typical of enterprise software.
